hypothesis: A frozen policy encoder applied to a fictitious root-active post-turn observation may generalize poorly. Encode the same state with its genuine next-active-player field, keeping candidate data, aggregate features, MLP, hard-choice objective and 20-epoch schedule unchanged.
decision: Reject. Neither the previously used root-perspective MLP nor this genuine-next-player variant beats static choice on independent offline maps. No full-game gate, rating, or deployment attempted; seed6300000 remains untouched.
interpretation: The mismatch in the earlier synthetic root-active encoder input was real, but correcting it was not sufficient. Repeated false overrides under the same hard-choice target point toward a target/decision-calibration problem or missing opponent-response representation; do not continue tweaking this objective on already-used validation windows.
